text: Kael Voss serves as a Sentinel operative (Stalker variant) under Sentinel High Command within the galactic_union faction. Distinct from Kael Durn (GU Supreme Military Commander).
Operation Silent Dagger: comms monitoring, hacking and entry support, and AI core shutdown support.
Member of the Silent Dagger team under Commander Aric Thal. Shares a surname with Darek Voss; relationship NOT established — do not infer kinship.
